topic: How a water treatment plant cleans river water

stages.name: Intake
stages.one_liner: Pumps pull river water in through screens that stop sticks and fish.

stages.name: Coagulation
stages.one_liner: A chemical makes tiny dirt bits stick together into clumps.

stages.name: Settling
stages.one_liner: Heavy clumps sink to the bottom of a big slow tank.

stages.name: Filtering
stages.one_liner: Water drips through sand and gravel that trap what is left.

stages.name: Disinfection
stages.one_liner: A small dose of chlorine or UV light kills germs.

stages.name: Storage and pipes
stages.one_liner: Clean water waits in a tank, then flows to homes.

quiz.q: Why add a chemical in coagulation?
quiz.a: So tiny dirt bits clump together and sink.
